terms.title: Booking terms
terms.demo: Prototype terms for demonstration. They describe how the platform behaves today.
terms.p1: Prices include taxes and are checked again before you confirm. If a price or availability changes, you see the change and decide.
terms.p2: You can pay in full by card, or in instalments where offered. Instalments always finish before the service date.
terms.p3: Each product shows its supplier's cancellation policy before you pay. Fees follow that policy; the refund is what you paid minus any fee.
terms.p4: Keep your password private. You can reset it with a one-time code sent to your email.
terms.p5: Contact us from your account's Help & support page with your booking reference.
